title: Promote latest core work into the free, lean, fast rc4 candidate
goal: Record the open-core boundary, preserve commercial functionality in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps, and publish the latest landed core work as an immutable release/2026-11-11-rc4 candidate without force-moving shared history.
limitations: The candidate remains unqualified until the exact release tree passes the full Windows x86_64 and Linux x86_64 release gates; source publication is not production qualification.

The current Windows host cannot rebuild the latest distiller because the installed MSVC/Windows SDK registration does not expose dbghelp.lib; receipt and Git object checks remain required for this candidate.
